Commit title: hhdgdiff
Commit body:
Summary:
I needed a way to compare .hhdg depgraph files generated by hh and hh_distc:

* compares two .hhdg files
* reports missing/extra nodes (hashes)
* reports hash collisions if revealed by colliding .txt entries
* reports missing/extra edges
* reads (hash, kind, symbol) triples from .txt files generated by `--save-human-readable-64bit-dep-map`
* displays all nodes/edges in human readable form when possible
